Title: Command of the Harpies vs. Contested Title

Messages.Author: Jeff DeBraal
Messages.Body: Can Command of the Haripies be used to remove a contested title from a vampire ?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4oiimu$g...@symiserver2.symantec.com>,

Jeff DeBraal <jde...@symantec.com> wrote:
>Can Command of the Haripies be used to remove a contested title from a vampire ?

No, card text says you must choose a ready Prince. A ready vampire with
a contested title is not a Prince.
